axisLength.doc: Default axis length in world units.

defaultAxisLineThickness.doc: Default axis line thickness in screen-space logical pixels.

secondaryAxisThicknessScale.doc: Secondary-frame axis thickness relative to the world axis thickness.

defaultAxisLabelSize.doc: Default axis label size. The fallback where no theme supplies one.

axisLabelOffsetPixels.doc: Screen-space offset from an axis endpoint to its label center.

worldAlignedLabelHeightMm.doc: Default world-space height of a world-aligned label.

calloutGapPixels.doc: Gap between the anchor point and the start of the angled leader segment.

calloutAngledLengthPixels.doc: Length of the angled leader segment.

calloutHorizontalLengthPixels.doc: Length of the horizontal leader segment.

calloutAngleDegrees.doc: Angle of the angled leader segment from horizontal.

calloutLeaderLineWidth.doc: Callout leader line width in screen-space logical pixels.

calloutBorderThickness.doc: Callout border width. Tied to the leader width: at thinner widths, horizontal and vertical lines antialias differently.

calloutLabelPixelSize.doc: Screen-pixel size of the callout label.

calloutOpacityNearDistance.doc: Distance at or below which a callout has maximum opacity.

calloutOpacityFarDistance.doc: Distance at or above which a callout has minimum opacity.

calloutOpacityMax.doc: Callout opacity at the near distance.

calloutOpacityMin.doc: Callout opacity at the far distance.
